sanskrit: pra va indrāya mādanaṁ haryaśvāya gāyata | sakhāyaḥ somapāvne ||
english: Sing forth to Indra, the exhilarating hymn, O friends, to him of the bay steeds, the drinker of Soma.

sanskrit: śaṁsed ukthaṁ sudānava uta dyukṣaṁ yathā naraḥ | cakṛmā satyarādhase ||
english: Let heroic men recite the laud and the bright offering as is fit, for him of liberal gifts — we have made them for Indra, the truly bounteous.

sanskrit: tvaṁ na indra vājayus tvaṁ gavyuḥ śatakrato | tvaṁ hiraṇyayur vaso ||
english: Thou, O Indra, art the seeker of prizes; thou, O Lord of a hundred powers, art the seeker of cattle; thou art the seeker of gold, O bright one.

sanskrit: vayam indra tvāyavo 'bhi pra ṇonumo vṛṣan | viddhī tv asya no vaso ||
english: We who are devoted to thee, O Indra, praise thee exceedingly, O Bull; mark well this our song, O bright one.

sanskrit: mā no nide ca vaktave 'ryo randhīr arāvṇe | tve api kratur mama ||
english: Deliver us not to blame nor to the speech of the hostile one, nor surrender us to one who does not give; in thee too rests my purpose.

sanskrit: tvaṁ varmāsi saprathaḥ puroyodhaś ca vṛtrahan | tvayā prati bruve yujā ||
english: Thou art our wide-spreading armour and our champion in the forefront, O Vṛtra-slayer; with thee as ally I speak in reply.

sanskrit: mahām̐ utāsi yasya te 'nu svadhāvarī sahaḥ | mamnāte indra rodasī ||
english: Great indeed art thou, whose might, self-sustaining, follows; both the worlds, O Indra, acknowledge thee.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā marutvatī pari bhuvad vāṇī sayāvarī | nakṣamāṇā saha dyubhiḥ ||
english: May the speech accompanied by the Maruts, moving together with the days, encompass thee, O Indra, reaching thee.

sanskrit: ūrdhvāsas tvānv indavo bhuvan dasmam upa dyavi | saṁ te namanta kṛṣṭayaḥ ||
english: The Soma-drops, standing upright, have flowed to thee, the wondrous one, toward heaven; the people bow down together to thee.

sanskrit: pra vo mahe mahivṛdhe bharadhvam pracetase pra sumatiṁ kṛṇudhvam | viśaḥ pūrvīḥ pra carā carṣaṇiprāḥ ||
english: Carry forward your praise to the great one, who is magnified by greatness, to the wise one; bestow your good-will; go forth, O many peoples who sustain human life.

sanskrit: uruvyacase mahine suvṛktim indrāya brahma janayanta viprāḥ | tasya vratāni na minanti dhīrāḥ ||
english: Wise seers generate the well-fashioned prayer for Indra, far-reaching and mighty; the steadfast ones do not transgress his ordinances.

sanskrit: indraṁ vāṇīr anuttamanyum eva satrā rājānaṁ dadhire sahadhyai | haryaśvāya barhayā sam āpīn ||
english: The sacred voices, ever unvanquished in wrath, have placed Indra together as king to drink in common; for the lord of bay steeds, press down and exhilarate the companions.

sanskrit: mo ṣu tvā vāghataś canāre asman ni rīraman | ārāttāc cit sadhamādaṁ na ā gahīha vā sann upa śrudhi ||
english: Let not the worshippers, nor any one, keep thee far from us; come hither from afar to our feast of exhilaration, or, being here, listen near at hand.

sanskrit: ime hi te brahmakṛtaḥ sute sacā madhau na makṣa āsate | indre kāmaṁ jaritāro vasūyavo rathe na pādam ā dadhuḥ ||
english: These hymn-makers of thine sit here with the pressed Soma as bees upon honey; the praisers desirous of wealth have set their desire in Indra, as a foot in a chariot.

sanskrit: rāyaskāmo vajrahastaṁ sudakṣiṇam putro na pitaraṁ huve ||
english: Desirous of wealth, I call Indra of the bolt-hand, well-skilled, as a son calls upon a father.

sanskrit: ima indrāya sunvire somāso dadhyāśiraḥ | tām̐ ā madāya vajrahasta pītaye haribhyāṁ yāhy oka ā ||
english: These Soma-draughts mixed with curds have been pressed for Indra; come to them for exhilaration, O bolt-handed one, to drink — come home with thy bay horses.

sanskrit: śravac chrutkarṇa īyate vasūnāṁ nū cin no mardhiṣad giraḥ | sadyaś cid yaḥ sahasrāṇi śatā dadan nakir ditsantam ā minat ||
english: The keen-eared one moves, hearing a call for riches; let him not now neglect our songs — he who can give thousands and hundreds in a day; no one can restrain the willing giver.

sanskrit: sa vīro apratiṣkuta indreṇa śūśuve nṛbhiḥ | yas te gabhīrā savanāni vṛtrahan sunoty ā ca dhāvati ||
english: That hero, unassailable, has blazed forth with Indra amid warriors — he who presses for thee, O Vṛtra-slayer, the deep Soma-pressings and hastens hither.

sanskrit: bhavā varūtham maghavan maghonāṁ yat samajāsi śardhataḥ | vi tvāhatasya vedanam bhajemahyā dūṇāśo bharā gayam ||
english: Be a shelter, O Maghavan, for the bountiful, when thou dost conquer the insolent; may we share the wealth of the one struck by thee — O unstrikable one, bring home riches.

sanskrit: sunotā somapāvne somam indrāya vajriṇe | pacatā paktīr avase kṛṇudhvam it pṛṇann it pṛṇate mayaḥ ||
english: Press the Soma for the Soma-drinker Indra, the wielder of the bolt; cook the offerings for our aid — truly the bounty of the liberal man delights the liberal.

sanskrit: mā sredhata somino dakṣatā mahe kṛṇudhvaṁ rāya ātuje | taraṇir ij jayati kṣeti puṣyati na devāsaḥ kavatnave ||
english: Do not falter, O Soma-pressers; be skilful; strive for great riches; truly the bold man wins, lives, and prospers — the gods are not for the niggardly.

sanskrit: nakiḥ sudāso ratham pary āsa na rīramat | indro yasyāvitā yasya maruto gamat sa gomati vraje ||
english: No one encompassed the chariot of Sudās to detain it; he whose helper is Indra, toward whom the Maruts come — he reaches the stall rich in cattle.

sanskrit: gamad vājaṁ vājayann indra martyo yasya tvam avitā bhuvaḥ | asmākam bodhy avitā rathānām asmākaṁ śūra nṛṇām ||
english: The mortal whose helper thou art, O Indra, wins the prize while pressing for prizes; be thou our helper of chariots, our helper of heroes, O champion.

sanskrit: ud in nv asya ricyate 'ṁśo dhanaṁ na jigyuṣaḥ | ya indro harivān na dabhanti taṁ ripo dakṣaṁ dadhāti somini ||
english: The portion of him truly springs up like the wealth of a victor — Indra with his bay horses; deceivers do not harm him; he who is at the Soma-pressing bestows skill.

sanskrit: mantram akharvaṁ sudhitaṁ supeśasaṁ dadhāta yajñiyeṣv ā | pūrvīś cana prasitayas taranti taṁ ya indre karmaṇā bhuvat ||
english: Place at the sacred rites the mighty, well-set, well-adorned prayer; even many pursuings do not overtake him who is engaged in work for Indra.

sanskrit: kas tam indra tvāvasum ā martyo dadharṣati | śraddhā it te maghavan pārye divi vājī vājaṁ siṣāsati ||
english: What mortal would dare to assail him who has thee as his wealth, O Indra? Truly, O Maghavan, by faith in thee on the appointed day in heaven, the swift steed wins the prize.

sanskrit: maghonaḥ sma vṛtrahatyeṣu codaya ye dadati priyā vasu | tava praṇītī haryaśva sūribhir viśvā tarema duritā ||
english: Urge the bountiful in the slaying of Vṛtra, those who give dear wealth; under thy guidance, O lord of bay steeds, may we with the inspired patrons pass through all difficulties.

sanskrit: taved indrāvamaṁ vasu tvam puṣyasi madhyamam | satrā viśvasya paramasya rājasi nakiṣ ṭvā goṣu vṛṇvate ||
english: The lowest wealth is thine, O Indra, and thou dost cultivate the middle sort; thou reignest over all that is highest; no one excludes thee from the cattle.

sanskrit: tvaṁ viśvasya dhanadā asi śruto ya īm bhavanty ājayaḥ | tavāyaṁ viśvaḥ puruhūta pārthivo 'vasyur nāma bhikṣate ||
english: Thou art the famed giver of wealth to all, whose victories come; O much-invoked one, this whole earthly world, desiring thy aid, begs thy name.

sanskrit: yad indra yāvatas tvam etāvad aham īśīya | stotāram id didhiṣeya radāvaso na pāpatvāya rāsīya ||
english: If I, O Indra, were as great as thou art, I would seek only the praiser to maintain; I would not give wealth, O giver, for wickedness.

sanskrit: śikṣeyam in mahayate dive-dive rāya ā kuhacidvide | nahi tvad anyan maghavan na āpyaṁ vasyo asti pitā cana ||
english: I would indeed assist the magnanimous one day by day for wealth found somewhere; truly, O Maghavan, there is no kinsman, not even a father, more helpful than thou.

sanskrit: taraṇir it siṣāsati vājam puraṁdhyā yujā | ā va indram puruhūtaṁ name girā nemiṁ taṣṭeva sudrvam ||
english: Truly the bold one wins the prize with Puraṁdhi as his ally; I bend Indra, the much-invoked, hither with a hymn, as a skilled carpenter bends a wheel-rim.

sanskrit: na duṣṭutī martyo vindate vasu na sredhantaṁ rayir naśat | suśaktir in maghavan tubhyam māvate deṣṇaṁ yat pārye divi ||
english: A mortal finds no wealth through ill-praise; riches do not come to the negligent; O Maghavan, good strength to thee — for one devoted to thee, a gift on the appointed day in heaven.

sanskrit: abhi tvā śūra nonumo 'dugdhā iva dhenavaḥ | īśānam asya jagataḥ svardṛśam īśānam indra tasthuṣaḥ ||
english: We praise thee exceedingly, O champion, as milch-cows that have not been milked; O Indra, the lord of this moving world, the heaven-beholder, the lord of the standing world.

sanskrit: na tvāvām̐ anyo divyo na pārthivo na jāto na janiṣyate | aśvāyanto maghavann indra vājino gavyantas tvā havāmahe ||
english: No other, neither heavenly nor earthly, born or yet to be born, is like thee; we who desire horses, O Maghavan Indra, we who are swift and who seek cattle — we call on thee.

sanskrit: abhī ṣatas tad ā bharendra jyāyaḥ kanīyasaḥ | purūvasur hi maghavan sanād asi bhare-bhare ca havyaḥ ||
english: O Indra, bring thou that — the greater for the lesser, the greater to the needy; for thou, O Maghavan, art of abundant wealth from of old and art to be invoked in every battle.

sanskrit: parā ṇudasva maghavann amitrān suvedā no vasū kṛdhi | asmākam bodhy avitā mahādhane bhavā vṛdhaḥ sakhīnām ||
english: Drive away the enemies, O Maghavan; make our riches easy to find; be thou our helper in the great contest, the strengthener of our friends.

sanskrit: indra kratuṁ na ā bhara pitā putrebhyo yathā | śikṣā ṇo asmin puruhūta yāmani jīvā jyotir aśīmahi ||
english: O Indra, bring us resolve as a father brings it to his sons; help us, O much-invoked, in this our journey; may we living reach the light.

sanskrit: mā no ajñātā vṛjanā durādhyo māśivāso ava kramuḥ | tvayā vayam pravataḥ śaśvatīr apo 'ti śūra tarāmasi ||
english: Let not unknown hostile powers, ill-intentioned, let not the inauspicious trample us; with thee, O champion, may we ever pass through the rushing streams.

sanskrit: śvityañco mā dakṣiṇataskapardā dhiyaṁjinvāso abhi hi pramanduḥ | uttiṣṭhan voce pari barhiṣo nṝn na me dūrād avitave vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
english: The white-complexioned, right-tufted Vasiṣṭhas, who gladden the mind with hymns, have gladdened me; rising up I declare before the men at the sacred grass — the Vasiṣṭhas have not been far from me as helpers.

sanskrit: dūrād indram anayann ā sutena tiro vaiśantam ati pāntam ugram | pāśadyumnasya vāyatasya somāt sutād indro 'vṛṇītā vasiṣṭhān ||
english: They brought Indra from afar with the pressed Soma, past Vaiśanta, past the mighty guardian; from the pressed Soma of Pāśadyumna Vāyata, Indra chose the Vasiṣṭhas.

sanskrit: even nu kaṁ sindhum ebhis tatāreven nu kam bhedam ebhir jaghāna | even nu kaṁ dāśarājñe sudāsam prāvad indro brahmaṇā vo vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
english: So with these he crossed the Sindhu; so with these he smote the adversary; so in the Battle of Ten Kings did Indra protect Sudās through your sacred formulas, O Vasiṣṭhas.

sanskrit: juṣṭī naro brahmaṇā vaḥ pitṝṇām akṣam avyayaṁ na kilā riṣātha | yac chakvarīṣu bṛhatā raveṇendre śuṣmam adadhātā vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
english: Through the sacred prayer of your fathers, the inexhaustible beneficent deed was performed by devoted men — you do not perish; for in the Śakvarī verses with a great cry you, the Vasiṣṭhas, placed your might in Indra.

sanskrit: ud dyām ivet tṛṣṇajo nāthitāso 'dīdhayur dāśarājñe vṛtāsaḥ | vasiṣṭhasya stuvata indro aśrod uruṁ tṛtsubhyo akṛṇod u lokam ||
english: Thirsty, beseeching, as though yearning for heaven, they shone in the Battle of Ten Kings, beset; Indra heard Vasiṣṭha as he praised, and made wide space for the Tṛtsus.

sanskrit: daṇḍā ived goajanāsa āsan paricchinnā bharatā arbhakāsaḥ | abhavac ca puraetā vasiṣṭha ād it tṛtsūnāṁ viśo aprathanta ||
english: The cattle-owners were like scattered staffs; the Bharatas were tiny and hemmed in; but Vasiṣṭha became their leader in the forefront, and straightway the clans of the Tṛtsus spread wide.

sanskrit: trayaḥ kṛṇvanti bhuvaneṣu retas tisraḥ prajā āryā jyotiragrāḥ | trayo gharmāsa uṣasaṁ sacante sarvām̐ it tām̐ anu vidur vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
english: Three pour their seed in the worlds; three Āryan offspring head toward the light; three warmths attend the Dawn — all these the Vasiṣṭhas know fully.

sanskrit: sūryasyeva vakṣatho jyotir eṣāṁ samudrasyeva mahimā gabhīraḥ | vātasyeva prajavo nānyena stomo vasiṣṭhā anvetave vaḥ ||
english: Their radiance is like the shining of the sun; their greatness is deep as the ocean; their swiftness is like the wind — no one else, O Vasiṣṭhas, may follow up your praise.

sanskrit: ta in niṇyaṁ hṛdayasya praketaiḥ sahasravalśam abhi saṁ caranti | yamena tatam paridhiṁ vayanto 'psarasa upa sedur vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
english: They move together around the hidden thing of the heart with the thoughts of a thousand branches; weaving the enclosure stretched out by Yama, the Vasiṣṭhas sat down with the Apsarases.

sanskrit: vidyuto jyotiḥ pari saṁjihānam mitrāvaruṇā yad apaśyatāṁ tvā | tat te janmotaikaṁ vasiṣṭhāgastyo yat tvā viśa ājabhāra ||
english: When Mitra and Varuṇa saw thee flashing around the light of the lightning — that is thy one birth, O Vasiṣṭha; the other is when Agastya brought thee among the Viśas.

sanskrit: utāsi maitrāvaruṇo vasiṣṭhorvaśyā brahman manaso 'dhi jātaḥ | drapsaṁ skannam brahmaṇā daivyena viśve devāḥ puṣkare tvādadanta ||
english: Thou art also the son of Mitra and Varuṇa, O Vasiṣṭha, born of Urvaśī from the mind, O brahmin; the seed that had fallen — all the gods received thee in the lotus with the divine prayer.

sanskrit: sa praketa ubhayasya pravidvān sahasradāna uta vā sadānaḥ | yamena tatam paridhiṁ vayiṣyann apsarasaḥ pari jajñe vasiṣṭhaḥ ||
english: He, the discerner, knowing both worlds, giver of thousands and one who possesses eternally — Vasiṣṭha was born amid the Apsarases, about to weave the enclosure stretched by Yama.

sanskrit: satre ha jātāv iṣitā namobhiḥ kumbhe retaḥ siṣicatuḥ samānam | tato ha māna ud iyāya madhyāt tato jātam ṛṣim āhur vasiṣṭham ||
english: Born together at the sacrifice, urged by devotion, they poured their commingled seed into a jar; thence Māna rose up in the midst; thence the seer born is called Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit: ukthabhṛtaṁ sāmabhṛtam bibharti grāvāṇam bibhrat pra vadāty agre | upainam ādhvaṁ sumanasyamānā ā vo gacchāti pratṛdo vasiṣṭhaḥ ||
english: He bears the bearer of laud, the bearer of Sāman, and bearing the pressing-stone he speaks forth first; approach him with goodwill — Vasiṣṭha will come to you, O Pratṛdas.

sanskrit: pra śukraitu devī manīṣā asmat sutaṣṭo ratho na vājī ||
english: Let the divine bright prayer go forth from us, well-fashioned as a swift racing-chariot.

sanskrit: viduḥ pṛthivyā divo janitraṁ śṛṇvanty āpo adha kṣarantīḥ ||
english: The flowing waters hear and know the birth-place of earth and heaven.

sanskrit: āpaś cid asmai pinvanta pṛthvīr vṛtreṣu śūrā maṁsanta ugrāḥ ||
english: Even the wide waters swell for him; in the battles against Vṛtras the mighty champions take thought.

sanskrit: ā dhūrṣv asmai dadhātāśvān indro na vajrī hiraṇyabāhuḥ ||
english: Yoke the horses for him at the pole, as Indra the bolt-wielder with arms of gold.

sanskrit: abhi pra sthātāheva yajñaṁ yāteva patman tmanā hinota ||
english: Go forth toward the sacrifice as on a given day; urge it of yourselves, as if going on a journey.

sanskrit: tmanā samatsu hinota yajñaṁ dadhāta ketuṁ janāya vīram ||
english: Of yourselves urge the sacrifice in the battles; set up a standard, a hero for the people.

sanskrit: ud asya śuṣmād bhānur nārta bibharti bhāram pṛthivī na bhūma ||
english: From his might the radiance has not faltered; the earth bears the weight as the ground.

sanskrit: hvayāmi devām̐ ayātur agne sādhann ṛtena dhiyaṁ dadhāmi ||
english: I invoke the gods; O Agni, unchecked, completing the work with holy order, I set my thought.

sanskrit: abhi vo devīṁ dhiyaṁ dadhidhvam pra vo devatrā vācaṁ kṛṇudhvam ||
english: Direct your divine thought; send forth your voice toward the gods.

sanskrit: ā caṣṭa āsām pātho nadīnāṁ varuṇa ugraḥ sahasracakṣāḥ ||
english: The mighty Varuṇa of a thousand eyes looks upon the depths of these rivers.

sanskrit: rājā rāṣṭrānām peśo nadīnām anuttam asmai kṣatraṁ viśvāyu ||
english: He is the king of kingdoms, the ornament of rivers; imperishable sovereignty, life for all, belongs to him.

sanskrit: aviṣṭo asmān viśvāsu vikṣv adyuṁ kṛṇota śaṁsaṁ ninitsoḥ ||
english: Protect us in all the clans; make our fame shine forth this day for the praiser.

sanskrit: vy etu didyud dviṣām aśevā yuyota viṣvag rapas tanūnām ||
english: Let the sinister lightning of enemies depart; ward off from all sides the blemish from our bodies.

sanskrit: avīn no agnir havyān namobhiḥ preṣṭho asmā adhāyi stomaḥ ||
english: Agni has protected us and our oblations with devotions; the most beloved praise has been placed for him.

sanskrit: sajūr devebhir apāṁ napātaṁ sakhāyaṁ kṛdhvaṁ śivo no astu ||
english: Make the Child of Waters our friend in common with the gods; may he be gracious to us.

sanskrit: abjām ukthair ahiṁ gṛṇīṣe budhne nadīnāṁ rajaḥsu ṣīdan ||
english: With hymns I praise the water-born serpent sitting in the dust at the base of the rivers.

sanskrit: mā no 'hir budhnyo riṣe dhān mā yajño asya sridhad ṛtāyoḥ ||
english: Let Ahi Budhnya not place us in harm; let not the sacrifice of this one who lives by holy order fail.

sanskrit: uta na eṣu nṛṣu śravo dhuḥ pra rāye yantu śardhanto aryaḥ ||
english: And may these heroic men lay fame upon us; may noble ones go forth boldly for wealth.

sanskrit: tapanti śatruṁ svar ṇa bhūmā mahāsenāso amebhir eṣām ||
english: Their great armies scorch the foe as the sun scorches the earth with its swift rays.

sanskrit: ā yan naḥ patnīr gamanty acchā tvaṣṭā supāṇir dadhātu vīrān ||
english: When our consorts come forward to us, may Tvaṣṭar of the fair hands bestow heroic men.

sanskrit: prati naḥ stomaṁ tvaṣṭā juṣeta syād asme aramatir vasūyuḥ ||
english: May Tvaṣṭar be pleased with our praise; may Aramati, seeking wealth, abide with us.

sanskrit: tā no rāsan rātiṣāco vasūny ā rodasī varuṇānī śṛṇotu | varūtrībhiḥ suśaraṇo no astu tvaṣṭā sudatro vi dadhātu rāyaḥ ||
english: May they, the bountiful ones, bestow wealth upon us; may Rodasī and Varuṇānī hear; may there be good refuge for us with their many protections; may Tvaṣṭar of good gifts distribute riches.

sanskrit: tan no rāyaḥ parvatās tan na āpas tad rātiṣāca oṣadhīr uta dyauḥ | vanaspatibhiḥ pṛthivī sajoṣā ubhe rodasī pari pāsato naḥ ||
english: May the mountains give us that wealth, may the waters, may the bountiful herbs and heaven; may earth, united with the forest-trees, may both the world-halves guard us around.

sanskrit: anu tad urvī rodasī jihātām anu dyukṣo varuṇa indrasakhā | anu viśve maruto ye sahāso rāyaḥ syāma dharuṇaṁ dhiyadhyai ||
english: May the wide two world-halves extend for that; may the mighty Varuṇa, Indra's friend; may all the powerful Maruts follow — may we be the firm foundation of wealth to contemplate.

sanskrit: tan na indro varuṇo mitro agnir āpa oṣadhīr vanino juṣanta | śarman syāma marutām upasthe yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: May Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni, the waters, the herbs, and the forest-trees bestow that on us; may we be in the lap of the Maruts for shelter; protect us ever with blessings.

sanskrit: śaṁ na indrāgnī bhavatām avobhiḥ śaṁ na indrāvaruṇā rātahavyā | śam indrāsomā suvitāya śaṁ yoḥ śaṁ na indrāpūṣaṇā vājasātau ||
english: May Indra and Agni be auspicious to us with their aids; may Indra and Varuṇa, to whom oblations are given, be auspicious; may Indra and Soma be gracious for our well-being; may Indra and Pūṣan be auspicious in the winning of prizes.

sanskrit: śaṁ no bhagaḥ śam u naḥ śaṁso astu śaṁ naḥ puraṁdhiḥ śam u santu rāyaḥ | śaṁ naḥ satyasya suyamasya śaṁsaḥ śaṁ no aryamā purujāto astu ||
english: May Bhaga be auspicious to us; may our praise also be auspicious; may Puraṁdhi be auspicious; may riches also be auspicious; may the praise of truth and good governance be auspicious to us; may Aryaman, born of many, be auspicious.

sanskrit: śaṁ no dhātā śam u dhartā no astu śaṁ na urūcī bhavatu svadhābhiḥ | śaṁ rodasī bṛhatī śaṁ no adriḥ śaṁ no devānāṁ suhavāni santu ||
english: May Dhātṛ be auspicious to us; may the Sustainer also be auspicious; may the wide-shining one be auspicious with her offerings; may the great Rodasī be auspicious; may the mountain be auspicious; may the good invocations of the gods be auspicious.

sanskrit: śaṁ no agnir jyotiranīko astu śaṁ no mitrāvaruṇāv aśvinā śam | śaṁ naḥ sukṛtāṁ sukṛtāni santu śaṁ na iṣiro abhi vātu vātaḥ ||
english: May Agni, the radiant-faced, be auspicious to us; may Mitra and Varuṇa be auspicious, and the Aśvins; may the good deeds of the good be auspicious to us; may the swift wind blow auspiciously upon us.

sanskrit: śaṁ no dyāvāpṛthivī pūrvahūtau śam antarikṣaṁ dṛśaye no astu | śaṁ na oṣadhīr vanino bhavantu śaṁ no rajasas patir astu jiṣṇuḥ ||
english: May Dyāvāpṛthivī be auspicious at the morning invocation; may the midspace be auspicious for us to behold; may the herbs and the forest-trees be auspicious; may the victorious lord of the dust-realm be auspicious to us.

sanskrit: śaṁ na indro vasubhir devo astu śam ādityebhir varuṇaḥ suśaṁsaḥ | śaṁ no rudro rudrebhir jalāṣaḥ śaṁ nas tvaṣṭā gnābhir iha śṛṇotu ||
english: May Indra the god be auspicious with the Vasus; may Varuṇa of fair praise be auspicious with the Ādityas; may Rudra the healing one be auspicious with the Rudras; may Tvaṣṭar with the Gnās hear and be auspicious.

sanskrit: śaṁ naḥ somo bhavatu brahma śaṁ naḥ śaṁ no grāvāṇaḥ śam u santu yajñāḥ | śaṁ naḥ svarūṇām mitayo bhavantu śaṁ naḥ prasvaḥ śam v astu vediḥ ||
english: May Soma be auspicious to us; may the sacred prayer be auspicious; may the pressing-stones be auspicious; may the sacrifices also be auspicious; may the timbers of the stakes be auspicious; may the sacrificial ladle be auspicious and the altar be auspicious.

sanskrit: śaṁ naḥ sūrya urucakṣā ud etu śaṁ naś catasraḥ pradiśo bhavantu | śaṁ naḥ parvatā dhruvayo bhavantu śaṁ naḥ sindhavaḥ śam u santv āpaḥ ||
english: May the Sun of wide vision rise auspiciously for us; may the four directions be auspicious; may the firm mountains be auspicious; may the rivers and the waters be auspicious.

sanskrit: śaṁ no aditir bhavatu vratebhiḥ śaṁ no bhavantu marutaḥ svarkāḥ | śaṁ no viṣṇuḥ śam u pūṣā no astu śaṁ no bhavitraṁ śam v astu vāyuḥ ||
english: May Aditi be auspicious to us with her ordinances; may the Maruts who win the light be auspicious; may Viṣṇu be auspicious; may Pūṣan also be auspicious; may our prosperity be auspicious and Vāyu be auspicious.

sanskrit: śaṁ no devaḥ savitā trāyamāṇaḥ śaṁ no bhavantūṣaso vibhātīḥ | śaṁ naḥ parjanyo bhavatu prajābhyaḥ śaṁ naḥ kṣetrasya patir astu śambhuḥ ||
english: May the god Savitṛ, protecting us, be auspicious; may the brightly shining Dawns be auspicious; may Parjanya be auspicious for our offspring; may the lord of the field, the bringer of blessing, be auspicious.

sanskrit: śaṁ no devā viśvadevā bhavantu śaṁ sarasvatī saha dhībhir astu | śam abhiṣācaḥ śam u rātiṣācaḥ śaṁ no divyāḥ pārthivāḥ śaṁ no apyāḥ ||
english: May the All-Gods be auspicious to us; may Sarasvatī along with understanding be auspicious; auspicious be those who encompass us, auspicious those who give gifts; may the divine, the earthly, and the aqueous beings be auspicious.

sanskrit: śaṁ naḥ satyasya patayo bhavantu śaṁ no arvantaḥ śam u santu gāvaḥ | śaṁ na ṛbhavaḥ sukṛtaḥ suhastāḥ śaṁ no bhavantu pitaro haveṣu ||
english: May the lords of truth be auspicious to us; may our horses be auspicious; may the cows also be auspicious; may the Ṛbhus, the well-doing, the skilled of hand, be auspicious; may the Fathers be auspicious to us at the invocations.

sanskrit: śaṁ no aja ekapād devo astu śaṁ no 'hir budhnyaḥ śaṁ samudraḥ | śaṁ no apāṁ napāt perur astu śaṁ naḥ pṛśnir bhavatu devagopā ||
english: May the god Aja Ekapād be auspicious to us; may Ahi Budhnya and the ocean be auspicious; may Apāṁ Napāt Pūru be auspicious; may Pṛśni, guarded by the gods, be auspicious.

sanskrit: ādityā rudrā vasavo juṣantedam brahma kriyamāṇaṁ navīyaḥ | śṛṇvantu no divyāḥ pārthivāso gojātā uta ye yajñiyāsaḥ ||
english: May the Ādityas, Rudras, and Vasus be pleased with this renewed prayer being offered; may the divine, the earthly, the cow-born ones, and all those worthy of worship hear us.

sanskrit: ye devānāṁ yajñiyā yajñiyānām manor yajatrā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ | te no rāsantām urugāyam adya yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Those who among the gods are most worthy of sacrifice, the adorable ones of Manu, the immortal knowers of holy order — may they bestow on us ample room this day; protect us ever with blessings.

sanskrit: pra brahmaitu sadanād ṛtasya vi raśmibhiḥ sasṛje sūryo gāḥ | vi sānunā pṛthivī sasra urvī pṛthu pratīkam adhy edhe agniḥ ||
english: Let the sacred prayer go forth from the seat of holy order; the Sun has sent out his rays and released the cows; the wide earth has spread herself along her ridge; Agni has shone with his broad face.

sanskrit: imāṁ vām mitrāvaruṇā suvṛktim iṣaṁ na kṛṇve asurā navīyaḥ | ino vām anyaḥ padavīr adabdho janaṁ ca mitro yatati bruvāṇaḥ ||
english: I make this well-fashioned hymn for you two, O Mitra and Varuṇa, lords of might — a newer refreshment; another of you two, the inviolable Ino, follows the path, and Mitra, as he speaks, maintains the people.

sanskrit: ā vātasya dhrajato ranta ityā apīpayanta dhenavo na sūdāḥ | maho divaḥ sadane jāyamāno 'cikradad vṛṣabhaḥ sasminn ūdhan ||
english: They came to rest in the path of the rushing wind; the cows — like good milch-kine — have caused to swell; born in the seat of the great heaven, the Bull has bellowed in that same udder.

sanskrit: girā ya etā yunajad dharī ta indra priyā surathā śūra dhāyū | pra yo manyuṁ ririkṣato mināty ā sukratum aryamaṇaṁ vavṛtyām ||
english: He who would yoke with a song those thy two beloved bay steeds, O Indra, with the beautiful chariot — O champion, the two who give nourishment — and who by his wrath destroys the attacker, I would turn hither Aryaman of good counsel.

sanskrit: yajante asya sakhyaṁ vayaś ca namasvinaḥ sva ṛtasya dhāman | vi pṛkṣo bābadhe nṛbhiḥ stavāna idaṁ namo rudrāya preṣṭham ||
english: Both birds and the reverent ones worship his friendship in the seat of holy order; having been praised by men, he spreads forth his nourishment — this most beloved reverence to Rudra.

sanskrit: ā yat sākaṁ yaśaso vāvaśānāḥ sarasvatī saptathī sindhumātā | yāḥ suṣvayanta sudughāḥ sudhārā abhi svena payasā pīpyānāḥ ||
english: When, crying out together for glory, Sarasvatī the seventh, mother of streams, and those who have sounded well — the good-milking, good-streaming ones — swell up with their own milk.

sanskrit: uta tye no maruto mandasānā dhiyaṁ tokaṁ ca vājino 'vantu | mā naḥ pari khyad akṣarā caranty avīvṛdhan yujyaṁ te rayiṁ naḥ ||
english: May these swift Maruts, rejoicing, protect our prayer and our offspring; may the imperishable ones moving around not overlook us; may they foster our wealth fit to be yoked.

sanskrit: pra vo mahīm aramatiṁ kṛṇudhvam pra pūṣaṇaṁ vidathyaṁ na vīram | bhagaṁ dhiyo 'vitāraṁ no asyāḥ sātau vājaṁ rātiṣācam puraṁdhim ||
english: Proclaim the great Aramati; proclaim Pūṣan, the hero of the assembly; proclaim Bhaga, the protector of understanding at this winning, the prize-seeker Puraṁdhi.

sanskrit: acchāyaṁ vo marutaḥ śloka etv acchā viṣṇuṁ niṣiktapām avobhiḥ | uta prajāyai gṛṇate vayo dhur yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: May this call go toward you, O Maruts; may it go toward Viṣṇu, the overseer of the pressed drink, with your aids; and may they assign strength for offspring to the singer; protect us ever with blessings.

sanskrit: ā vo vāhiṣṭho vahatu stavadhyai ratho vājā ṛbhukṣaṇo amṛktaḥ | abhi tripṛṣṭhaiḥ savaneṣu somair made suśiprā mahabhiḥ pṛṇadhvam ||
english: May the unimpeded chariot, O Ṛbhukṣans, the swiftest bearer of prizes, carry you hither to be praised; at the pressings fill yourselves with the triple-ridged Soma-draughts in exhilaration, O fair-cheeked ones, with great gifts.

sanskrit: yūyaṁ ha ratnam maghavatsu dhattha svardṛśa ṛbhukṣaṇo amṛktam | saṁ yajñeṣu svadhāvantaḥ pibadhvaṁ vi no rādhāṁsi matibhir dayadhvam ||
english: You, O unimpeded Ṛbhukṣans, truly place the imperishable jewel among the bountiful, the heaven-beholding ones; drink your fill with your own power at the sacrifices; distribute your gifts to us with your thoughts.

sanskrit: uvocitha hi maghavan deṣṇam maho arbhasya vasuno vibhāge | ubhā te pūrṇā vasunā gabhastī na sūnṛtā ni yamate vasavyā ||
english: For thou, O Maghavan, hast spoken of the gift in the distribution of great and small wealth; both thy arms are full of wealth; true speech cannot be constrained when there is desire for riches.

sanskrit: tvam indra svayaśā ṛbhukṣā vājo na sādhur astam eṣy ṛkvā | vayaṁ nu te dāśvāṁsaḥ syāma brahma kṛṇvanto harivo vasiṣṭhāḥ ||
english: Thou, O Indra, art the self-glorious Ṛbhukṣan; O praised one, like a good steed thou goest home; may we, the Vasiṣṭhas, be worshippers devoted to thee, composing the sacred prayer, O lord of bay horses.

sanskrit: sanitāsi pravato dāśuṣe cid yābhir viveṣo haryaśva dhībhiḥ | vavanmā nu te yujyābhir ūtī kadā na indra rāya ā daśasyeḥ ||
english: Thou art the winner of the downward-rushing streams even for the worshipper, O lord of bay steeds, through those thoughts with which thou aidest; let me be joined to thy allied aids — when, O Indra, wilt thou bestow wealth upon us?

sanskrit: vāsayasīva vedhasas tvaṁ naḥ kadā na indra vacaso bubodhaḥ | astaṁ tātyā dhiyā rayiṁ suvīram pṛkṣo no arvā ny uhīta vājī ||
english: Thou art as if clothing us, O wise one; when, O Indra, hast thou heeded our speech? With thought going home, bring wealth rich in heroes; may our steed bring the prize-winning nourishment for us.

sanskrit: abhi yaṁ devī nirṛtiś cid īśe nakṣanta indraṁ śaradaḥ supṛkṣaḥ ||
english: Whom even the goddess Nirṛti controls — the autumns of good nourishment reach Indra.

sanskrit: ā no rādhāṁsi savitaḥ stavadhyā ā rāyo yantu parvatasya rātau | sadā no divyaḥ pāyuḥ siṣaktu yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: May gifts come to us to be praised, O Savitṛ; may wealth come at the bounty of the mountain; may the divine guardian attend us always; protect us ever with blessings.

sanskrit: ud u ṣya devaḥ savitā yayāma hiraṇyayīm amatiṁ yām aśiśret ||
english: The god Savitṛ has stretched upward the golden luster which he put on.

sanskrit: ud u tiṣṭha savitaḥ śrudhy asya hiraṇyapāṇe prabhṛtāv ṛtasya | vy urvīm pṛthvīm amatiṁ sṛjāna ā nṛbhyo martabhojanaṁ suvānaḥ ||
english: Rise up, O Savitṛ, O golden-handed; hear this, at the proper presentation of holy order; sending forth the wide, flat radiance, bestowing on men the food of mortals.

sanskrit: api ṣṭutaḥ savitā devo astu yam ā cid viśve vasavo gṛṇanti | sa naḥ stomān namasyaś cano dhād viśvebhiḥ pātu pāyubhir ni sūrīn ||
english: May the god Savitṛ, praised by all, be here — he whom all the Vasus also sing; may he who deserves reverence bestow on us and his devotees his grace with the praise; may he protect the wise men with all his guardians.

sanskrit: abhi yaṁ devy aditir gṛṇāti savaṁ devasya savitur juṣāṇā | abhi samrājo varuṇo gṛṇanty abhi mitrāso aryamā sajoṣāḥ ||
english: Whom the divine Aditi praises, rejoicing in the stimulation of god Savitṛ; whom the sovereign Varuṇa praises; whom the Mitras and Aryaman praise together.

sanskrit: abhi ye mitho vanuṣaḥ sapante rātiṁ divo rātiṣācaḥ pṛthivyāḥ | ahir budhnya uta naḥ śṛṇotu varūtry ekadhenubhir ni pātu ||
english: Those who win against each other in rivalry, seeking the gift of heaven, the bounty-sharers of earth — may Ahi Budhnya hear us too, and may Varūtrī protect us with her single milch-kines.

sanskrit: anu tan no jāspatir maṁsīṣṭa ratnaṁ devasya savitur iyānaḥ | bhagam ugro 'vase johavīti bhagam anugro adha yāti ratnam ||
english: Following that, may the lord of the family take thought, seeking the jewel of god Savitṛ; the mighty man repeatedly calls on Bhaga for aid; the mighty man, following Bhaga, then finds the jewel.

sanskrit: śaṁ no bhavantu vājino haveṣu devatātā mitadravaḥ svarkāḥ ||
english: May those who win prizes be auspicious to us at the invocations — the swift-running ones, winners of light, in their divine succession.

sanskrit: vāje-vāje 'vata vājino no dhaneṣu viprā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ | asya madhvaḥ pibata mādayadhvaṁ tṛptā yāta pathibhir devayānaiḥ ||
english: Protect us prize-winners in every contest for wealth, O wise immortal knowers of holy order; drink of this mead and make yourselves exhilarated; go satisfied along the god-traveled paths.

sanskrit: ūrdhvo agniḥ sumatiṁ vasvo aśret pratīcī jūrṇir devatātim eti | bhejāte adrī rathyeva panthām ṛtaṁ hotā na iṣito yajāti ||
english: Agni, erect, has reached good thought and wealth; the aging one goes to meet the divine succession; the two pressing-stones have found their path as of a chariot; the Hotṛ, impelled by holy order, sacrifices for us.

sanskrit: pra vāvṛje suprayā barhir eṣām ā viśpatīva bīriṭa iyāte | viśām aktor uṣasaḥ pūrvahūtau vāyuḥ pūṣā svastaye niyutvān ||
english: The sacred grass has been well spread for these; the two lords of the clan move here like a fissure; at the morning invocation of the people, at the Dawn, Vāyu and Pūṣan harnessed for well-being come hither.

sanskrit: jmayā atra vasavo ranta devā urāv antarikṣe marjayanta śubhrāḥ | arvāk patha urujrayaḥ kṛṇudhvaṁ śrotā dūtasya jagmuṣo no asya ||
english: Here on the earth the Vasus and the bright gods have rejoiced; in the broad midspace they have cleansed themselves; O far-going ones, make the paths hither; hear the message of this our envoy who has gone.

sanskrit: te hi yajñeṣu yajñiyāsa ūmāḥ sadhasthaṁ viśve abhi santi devāḥ | tām̐ adhvara uśato yakṣy agne śruṣṭī bhagaṁ nāsatyā puraṁdhim ||
english: For they, the worshipful, the helpful at the sacrifices — all the gods are about the common station; O Agni, worship those who long for the sacrifice — the gift, the Nāsatyas, and Puraṁdhi.

sanskrit: āgne giro diva ā pṛthivyā mitraṁ vaha varuṇam indram agnim | āryamaṇam aditiṁ viṣṇum eṣāṁ sarasvatī maruto mādayantām ||
english: O Agni, bring hither by our songs from heaven and earth: Mitra, Varuṇa, Indra, and Agni; Aryaman, Aditi, and Viṣṇu of these — may Sarasvatī and the Maruts exhilarate them.

sanskrit: rare havyam matibhir yajñiyānāṁ nakṣat kāmam martyānām asinvan | dhātā rayim avidasyaṁ sadāsāṁ sakṣīmahi yujyebhir nu devaiḥ ||
english: He has bestowed the oblation with the thoughts of those worthy of sacrifice; it reaches the desire of mortals, making them content; may Dhātṛ grant the inexhaustible wealth of those who sit at ease — may we conquer now with the allied gods.

sanskrit: nū rodasī abhiṣṭute vasiṣṭhair ṛtāvāno varuṇo mitro agniḥ | yacchantu candrā upamaṁ no arkaṁ yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Now Varuṇa, Mitra, and Agni, possessors of holy order, are praised through these Rodasīs by the Vasiṣṭhas; may the bright ones bestow the highest praise upon us; protect us ever with blessings.

sanskrit: o śruṣṭir vidathyā sam etu prati stomaṁ dadhīmahi turāṇām | yad adya devaḥ savitā suvāti syāmāsya ratnino vibhāge ||
english: Let the auspicious call come together at the assembly; let us set up our praise for the swift ones; whatever the god Savitṛ stimulates today, may we be among those who share in his jewels.

sanskrit: mitras tan no varuṇo rodasī ca dyubhaktam indro aryamā dadātu | dideṣṭu devy aditī rekṇo vāyuś ca yan niyuvaite bhagaś ca ||
english: May Mitra grant us that, and Varuṇa, and the Rodasīs, and Indra the heaven-apportioned share, and Aryaman; may the divine Aditi show the way to wealth; and Vāyu and Bhaga, whom they yoke together.

sanskrit: sed ugro astu marutaḥ sa śuṣmī yam martyam pṛṣadaśvā avātha | utem agniḥ sarasvatī junanti na tasya rāyaḥ paryetāsti ||
english: He shall be mighty and powerful, that mortal whom ye, O speckle-horsed Maruts, protect; and Agni and Sarasvatī urge him on — the limits of his wealth are not to be passed.

sanskrit: ayaṁ hi netā varuṇa ṛtasya mitro rājāno aryamāpo dhuḥ | suhavā devy aditir anarvā te no aṁho ati parṣann ariṣṭān ||
english: For this Varuṇa is the guide of holy order; the royal Mitras and Aryaman have set the waters in their place; the divine Aditi, easily invoked, the unassailable — may they carry us past our afflictions, unharmed.

sanskrit: asya devasya mīḻhuṣo vayā viṣṇor eṣasya prabhṛthe havirbhiḥ | vide hi rudro rudriyam mahitvaṁ yāsiṣṭaṁ vartir aśvināv irāvat ||
english: We are a branch of this bountiful god, in the forward offering of advancing Viṣṇu with oblations; for Rudra knows his mighty Rudrean greatness; may the Aśvins, possessing refreshment, find the most excellent track.

sanskrit: mātra pūṣann āghṛṇa irasyo varūtrī yad rātiṣācaś ca rāsan | mayobhuvo no arvanto ni pāntu vṛṣṭim parijmā vāto dadātu ||
english: O Pūṣan, radiant, when the shelter and the bountiful givers bestow gifts — may those who are sources of joy guard our horses; may the all-encompassing wind grant us rain.

sanskrit: nū rodasī abhiṣṭute vasiṣṭhair ṛtāvāno varuṇo mitro agniḥ | yacchantu candrā upamaṁ no arkaṁ yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Now Varuṇa, Mitra, and Agni, the possessors of holy order, are praised through the Rodasīs by the Vasiṣṭhas; may the bright ones bestow the highest praise upon us; protect us ever with blessings.
